- TOTAL revenue reached £61.8k TW versus £55.3k LW, a WoW gain of 11.8%.
- TOTAL units came in at 21,178 TW, up 13.4% WoW, while TOTAL orders held at 1,154 TW, up 0.1% WoW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER ranked 1 TW with £8,406.79, equal to 13.6% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- EDWARDIAN PARASOL BLACK delivered £3,448.60 TW (5.6% share) and FAIRY CAKE CANDLES £3,065.02 TW (5.0% share).
- RED/WHITE DOTS RUFFLED UMBRELLA posted £3,021.80 TW and EDWARDIAN PARASOL NATURAL £2,935.10 TW, with the top five products at 33.8% of TOTAL revenue TW.
- Largest WoW gains came from WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER at £3,464.60, FAIRY CAKE CANDLES at £1,683.17 and SCOTTIE DOG HOT WATER BOTTLE at £1,035.87.
- Largest WoW declines were PAPER CHAIN KIT 50'S CHRISTMAS at £3,461.35, WHITE CHERRY LIGHTS at £1,427.86 and ASSORTED COLOUR BIRD ORNAMENT at £1,114.15.
- On a percentage basis GREY HEART HOT WATER BOTTLE rose 126.7% WoW and FAIRY CAKE CANDLES rose 121.8% WoW.
